provenance.author: Devansh Gupta (DevaOnL)
provenance.acceptance: Candidate only: PR #44 and submission revision not independently accepted; #41 unit classification and both reports require independent teammate review.
provenance.configuration:
[run]
branch = True
source = accounts,allocations,audit,hms,hostels,payments,reports,scripts,students
omit =
    */migrations/*
    */tests.py
    */test_*.py
    */apps.py
    */__init__.py
    */settings.py
    */asgi.py
    */wsgi.py

[report]
fail_under = 70
show_missing = True
skip_empty = True
provenance.unit_configuration:
[run]
dynamic_context = test_function
branch = True
source = accounts,allocations,audit,hms,hostels,payments,reports,scripts,students
omit =
    */migrations/*
    */tests.py
    */test_*.py
    */apps.py
    */__init__.py
    */settings.py
    */asgi.py
    */wsgi.py

[report]
contexts = ^hms\.test_(forms|http|responses)\..*\.test_
fail_under = 70
show_missing = True
skip_empty = True
